cards.mood: The piece opens with an atmospheric and slightly melancholic tone that quickly builds anticipation through rising tension.
cards.palette: A massive, distorted saw-wave synthesizer lead serves as the core melodic hook, entering forcefully at the first drop and recurring as the dominant voice in all high-energy sections.
